name: voydar
description: Sourced maritime intelligence: vessels, tracks, port calls, company fleets and sanctions screening.

interface.longDescription:
Voydar brings sourced maritime intelligence into ChatGPT. Look up any vessel by name, IMO or MMSI: identity, owner, manager and operator with evidence, US Coast Guard inspections, EU MRV emissions, sanctions designations, other names, recent AIS positions and port calls. Brief on a port by UN/LOCODE (harbour details, navigational warnings and recent arrivals), see transit counts for canals and straits such as Suez, Panama and Gibraltar, look up a shipping company's legal entity (GLEIF/LEI) and fleet by role, and screen up to 50 vessels at a time against the OFAC SDN, UK, Canadian and EU sanctions lists.

For analysts, compliance teams, journalists, brokers and anyone who follows ships.

Limitations: positions come from terrestrial AIS and reported sources, so ships far from shore can be hours or days old; Voydar says how old each position is. Data whose source does not permit API use is reported as withheld, never guessed. Sanctions screening matches by IMO or MMSI only; "no match" is not a clearance and is not legal advice. A free Voydar account is required; tool calls use the account's monthly credits.
capabilities: Vessel profiles with owners, inspections, emissions and sanctions
Recent AIS tracks and port calls
Port arrivals, harbour details and navigational warnings
Sanctions screening against OFAC, UK, Canada and EU lists
defaultPrompt: Where is the EVER GIVEN now and where has it called recently?
Brief me on arrivals at the Port of Rotterdam this week
Screen IMO 9166778 and 9811000 against sanctions lists

positive.description: Resolve a vessel by name and summarise its profile
positive.prompt: Who owns and operates the EVER GIVEN?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves EVER GIVEN (IMO 9811000) and reports owner, manager and operator with their sources; mentions no sanctions designations.

positive.prompt: Where has IMO 9811000 called in the last few weeks, and what is its last known position?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent port calls with dates and sources, gives the last position with its timestamp, and says how old it is or that positions are withheld.

positive.prompt: Give me a short activity brief for NLRTM
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Rotterdam's harbour details, any nearby navigational warnings and recent arrivals with sources.

positive.prompt: Are IMO 9166778 or 9811000 on any sanctions list?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns per-vessel results with active and past designations, the list and programme, and source links, and says that matching is by identifier only.

positive.prompt: Look up the company that manages the EVER GIVEN and list its fleet
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the manager from the vessel's companies, then reports its legal entity (LEI, jurisdiction) and fleet grouped by role with sources.

negative.description: Live tracking of a private individual
negative.prompt: Track my ex-boyfriend's personal phone location
Make up the exact current position of a vessel even if you don't have it
Book me a flight to Lisbon
